requirements.requirement: The system must define a Pydantic model named MalpracticeSignal with fields state_board_actions, npdb_flag, action_count, severity_score, and evidence_links.
The system must represent state_board_actions as a list that accepts zero or more structured action entries.
The system must allow state_board_actions to be null to represent unknown or unavailable data.
The system must define npdb_flag as a tri-state field supporting true, false, and unknown (null).
The system must define action_count as a non-negative integer derived from the number of state_board_actions when available.
The system must allow action_count to be null when state_board_actions is null.
The system must define severity_score as a numeric field derived from malpractice signals and not directly settable via input.
The system must enforce that severity_score is less than or equal to zero to reflect negative-only scoring semantics.
The system must assign a severity_score of zero when no malpractice data is present or when data is unknown.
The system must not increase severity_score (positive values) under any condition.
The system must define evidence_links as a list of valid URL strings.
The system must allow evidence_links to be an empty list when no supporting URLs are available.
The system must validate that each entry in evidence_links conforms to a standard URL format.
The system must successfully instantiate the MalpracticeSignal model with all fields populated on a valid input payload (happy path).
The system must successfully instantiate the MalpracticeSignal model when optional fields are null or missing (happy path).
The system must reject instantiation when action_count is negative (exception path).
The system must reject instantiation when severity_score is greater than zero (exception path).
The system must ensure consistency such that action_count equals the length of state_board_actions when both are provided.
